routes.name: Visa-free short stay (Schengen 90/180)
routes.summary: Citizens of countries on the EU visa-exempt list can stay in Hungary and the rest of Schengen up to 90 days in any 180 days. No work or study allowed on this basis.

other: Nationals listed as visa-exempt in Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806.
Stays over 30 days must be registered through Enter Hungary.

stay.note: If a residence permit expires, the 90/180 right comes back, but as a tourist only.

routes.name: Extra stay under bilateral visa-free agreements
routes.summary: Some nationalities get an extra 30 or 90 days in Hungary on top of the Schengen 90, but only in Hungary. You must leave Schengen directly from Hungary on the last day.

other: 90 extra days: US, Andorra, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, South Korea, Hong Kong, Israel, Japan, Canada, Macau, Malaysia, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, New Zealand, Uruguay, Venezuela. 30 extra days: San Marino, Singapore.
Must not have used the Schengen 90 days elsewhere in the previous six months.
Cannot enter another Schengen state during the extra stay.
Not valid for work or study.

stay.note: 30 or 90 days extra depending on nationality, Hungary only.

routes.name: White Card (Digital Nomad Residence Permit)
routes.summary: One-year permit for non-EU remote workers employed abroad or owning a foreign company. Renewable once for another year. No work for Hungarian employers.

income.note: Net, for the six months before entry and throughout the stay

other: Verified employment abroad or ownership of a foreign company with proven profits.
Must work from Hungary using advanced digital technology.
No gainful activity in Hungary and no share in a Hungarian company.
Not available to people eligible for other Hungarian permits, students, posted workers, or asylum seekers.
Needs accommodation proof, comprehensive health insurance and a valid passport.
Family reunification not allowed for holders. Does not lead to a national residence card. Fee is on a separate OIF fee page, not read.

stay.note: Extension once for one more year, only in Hungary. Needs 90 days in Hungary in the previous 180.

steps: Apply at a Hungarian consulate, or in Hungary through Enter Hungary if you are visa-free and legally present.
Submit the form with the White Card appendix, photo and fingerprints, and pay the fee.
If approved abroad, you get a single-entry D visa valid 3 months, 30 days stay.
Enter Hungary within 3 months. The permit is mailed to your address.
documents: Six months of bank statements or income certificate
Valid passport and return ticket or funds
routes.processing: Procedural period is 21 days, with a decision due within 30 days of submission, not counting time to fix missing documents.

routes.name: Guest Investor Residence Permit
routes.summary: Residence for people who invest EUR 250,000 in an approved real estate fund or donate EUR 1,000,000 to a qualifying university foundation. Valid up to 10 years. Reports exist of a plan to end the program, which I could not confirm.

investment.note: Real estate fund units held 5 years. Alternative: EUR 1,000,000 donation to a higher education institution run by a public-benefit foundation.

other: Third-country nationals only.
Fund must keep at least 40% of net assets in Hungarian residential property and be run by a manager on the qualified list.
Need a guest investor visa, or be visa-exempt and apply within 30 days of entry.
Program status for 2027 and later is unconfirmed. Check with OIF.

stay.note: Extendable by up to 10 years. Fund units must still be held at renewal. Donation route needs no further investment.

steps: Get a guest investor visa, or enter visa-free.
Apply in Hungary via Enter Hungary or the regional OIF office. Biometrics are taken in person.
Submit proof of investment by the deadline (visa validity, or 6 months after first entry for some nationals).
routes.processing: 21 days, not counting missing documents or investment checks.

routes.name: Guest Self-Employed Residence Permit
routes.summary: For sole traders or company executives. First permit up to 1 year, total up to 3 years. Does not lead to permanent residence.

other: Sole traders: tax authority certificate showing annual business income above 24 times the minimum wage, plus no tax arrears.
Company executives: company employs at least 5 Hungarian or EEA staff full-time for 6 months, or your presence is essential and the company can sustain itself.
Proof of funds for living, housing, travel and healthcare.
Family reunification generally not allowed in the first year. Fee on separate OIF page.

stay.note: Extendable up to 2 more years, 3 years max in total.

routes.name: Employment residence permits (National Card, Hungarian Card, EU Blue Card)
routes.summary: Work routes for third-country nationals with a Hungarian employer. OIF lists a National Card for certain Balkan and Eastern European nationals, a Hungarian Card for degree holders in listed fields, and an EU Blue Card above a salary threshold.

other: National Card: citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Belarus, Moldova, Montenegro, Russia, Serbia or Ukraine.
Hungarian Card: degree in IT, technical, natural sciences, or certain music teaching fields.
EU Blue Card: gross monthly salary above a set threshold. Amount not confirmed here.
Other OIF pages cover work without a degree, with secondary education, ICT managers, intra-company transfers, seasonal work, researchers and trainees. Details not read.

sources.label: OIF: employment with a university degree

routes.name: Study Residence Permit
routes.summary: For full-time students at recognized Hungarian schools or universities. Valid 1 to 3 years, renewable. Part-time work allowed.

other: Admission to a recognized institution or preparatory course.
Proof of enough funds and tuition payment.
Full health coverage.
Adequate language proficiency for the course.
Work: up to 30 hours a week in term, full-time up to 90 days a year outside term.

stay.note: Initial permit at least 1 year or the course length if shorter, up to 3 years.

steps: Apply at a Hungarian consulate or in Hungary through Enter Hungary.
Pay the fee and give biometrics within 15 days.
Collect on a D visa valid 3 months.

routes.name: Job Seeking or Business Start Permit (after study or research)
routes.summary: Nine-month permit for graduates and researchers in Hungary who want to find a job or start a business matching their field. Not extendable.

other: Valid study or research permit, finished the studies or research.
Registered as job seeker, or a signed letter from a Hungarian company that will hire you within 3 months.
Proof of funds, accommodation and health coverage.
Apply 15 days before the current permit expires, only online in Hungary.

routes.processing: About 15 days, final decision within 60 days.

sources.label: OIF: job seeking or starting a business

routes.name: Family Reunification Residence Permit
routes.summary: For spouses, registered partners and minor children of Hungarian citizens or third-country residents. Up to 3 years normally, up to 5 for family of Hungarian citizens.

other: Family means spouse or registered partner, minor children, and in some refugee cases other close relatives.
Sponsors who cannot bring family: seasonal workers, White Card holders, students, trainees, volunteers, work permit holders.
Proof of livelihood, accommodation and health coverage. No fixed income amount is listed.
Work is only allowed through the combined application procedure.

stay.note: Up to 4 years with an EU Blue Card or Corporate Card sponsor, up to 5 years with a Hungarian citizen or EU residence card sponsor, up to 10 years with a guest investor sponsor.

routes.processing: 21 days, up to 70 days when combined with a work application.

routes.name: Working Holiday Residence Permit
routes.summary: Limited yearly quotas for citizens of 11 partner countries. Applications are rejected once a country's quota is full.

other: Yearly quotas: Argentina 200, Australia 500, Chile 200, South Korea 100, Ecuador 100, Hong Kong 200, Japan 200, Colombia 100, Peru 100, Taiwan 100, New Zealand 100.
Argentine, Ecuadorian and Colombian nationals cannot apply from inside Hungary.
Age limits and duration not stated on the OIF page. Check each agreement.

routes.name: EU/EEA citizen registration and free movement
routes.summary: EU/EEA citizens can live and work in Hungary and register with OIF for a registration certificate. Third-country family members get a residence card.

other: Conditions and timelines were not read from the official page. Check OIF.

routes.name: National Residence Card (long-term residence)
routes.summary: Permanent-style residence for third-country nationals after 3 years of continuous legal residence. Valid up to 10 years and renewable. Needs the Hungarian cultural knowledge exam.

other: 3 years of continuous lawful residence right before applying, or family-based shortcuts (for example 1 year as a dependent parent of a citizen, or spouse married at least 2 years).
Pass the Hungarian cultural knowledge exam.
Proof of livelihood, housing and health coverage. No minimum amount stated.
Clean record. Residents on White Card, guest self-employed, seasonal, student and similar permits are excluded.
Apply only online through Enter Hungary. Fee on separate OIF page.

routes.name: Naturalization (ordinary)
routes.summary: Eight years of residence in Hungary, plus a Hungarian constitution exam in Hungarian. Shorter periods apply to people born in Hungary and refugees.

eligibility.language: Constitution exam taken in Hungarian. Exempt: age 65+, graduates of Hungarian-language schools, certain health cases.
other: 8 years of residence generally. 5 years if born in Hungary or arrived as a minor. 3 years for refugees.
Accommodation and income in Hungary, clean criminal record, permanent residence document and a registered address.
The state of the person must not threaten public or national security.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship is not addressed on this page. The Hungarian Embassy in Washington says Hungary accepts multiple citizenship.

sources.label: Hungary Government: acquisition of Hungarian nationality
Embassy of Hungary, Washington: about citizenship

routes.name: Naturalization for spouses of Hungarian citizens
routes.summary: Three years of residence if you are the spouse of a Hungarian citizen and your minor child is a Hungarian citizen. Other preferential routes exist for family of citizens.

other: Spouse of a Hungarian citizen whose minor child is a Hungarian citizen.
Constitution exam, clean record, accommodation, income and registered address as in ordinary naturalization.

sources.label: Hungary Government: acquisition of Hungarian nationality

routes.name: Simplified Naturalization
routes.summary: For people with Hungarian ancestors, and for spouses of citizens, who speak Hungarian. No residence in Hungary needed for the ancestry route.

other: Former citizens, or children and grandchildren of people who lost Hungarian citizenship.
Descendants of Hungarian ancestors who left before September 1, 1929.
Spouses of citizens: married at least 10 years, or at least 5 years with a child together.
The embassy page does not list a criminal record rule or fees. Ask the embassy.

citizenship.note: Hungary and the US both accept multiple citizenship per the Hungarian Embassy in Washington.

sources.label: Embassy of Hungary, Washington: about citizenship

routes.name: Citizenship by descent or birth
routes.summary: Children of Hungarian citizens are Hungarian citizens by descent, regardless of birthplace. Foundlings and some stateless children born in Hungary also qualify.

other: Descent applies automatically. A child with a Hungarian mother and non-Hungarian father who missed out under old pre-1957 rules can apply by declaration.
Born in Hungary to stateless parents is presumed Hungarian unless shown otherwise.

sources.label: Hungary Government: acquisition of Hungarian nationality
